titulo.alumno: Sending a parcel and asking about the cost

intro: In this lesson you will practice sending a parcel and asking about the cost.

texto: Identify which details the form asks for and in what order; also check the amount, deadline and proof of payment.

frases.estudio: Πόσο κοστίζει να στείλω αυτό το δέμα στην Κρήτη;
frases.alumno: How much does it cost to send this package to Crete?

frases.estudio: Η απόδειξη δείχνει ότι η πληρωμή έγινε χθες το απόγευμα.
frases.alumno: The receipt shows the payment was made yesterday afternoon.

frases.estudio: Στο έντυπο διαμονής γράψτε τη διεύθυνση και τις ημερομηνίες.
frases.alumno: On the accommodation form, write the address and the dates.

pregunta.texto: Listen to the instructions and recognize the detail to be completed or checked.
